_readme: Hand-written golden questions for the Berkshire Hathaway 2021-2023 annual reports.
Ground truth was read directly from the ingested corpus (page numbers verified
against the stored chunks). A question counts as retrieved-correctly if ANY top-k
chunk matches expected_page_numbers OR contains expected_answer_substring.
Substrings are taken verbatim from pdfplumber's extraction, which sometimes drops
spaces inside table rows (e.g. '174.3billion') — that is intentional, not a typo.
expected_answer is human reference only; it is not used for matching.
